Quiet Monday. Someone's dog collapsed on a walk yesterday and today she's interested in a leaf again, which is exactly how you know a dog is coming back. I told her that. Then I took everything I know about "can I have some?" and turned it into a plain little list anyone can use: 48 foods, ok, careful or no, each with a reason. Grapes no. Carrots yes. Corn cob, absolutely not, however nicely I ask. It feels good to make something that might quietly end up inside someone else's app keeping a dog safe.
